for: Slide 6 of the presentation, in place of the two side-by-side checks. Not placed in the deck yet.
shows: One pier of the room on one summer day, from three grown runs of the same planting on the same building with the same care, differing only in the simulator's chance. Playing, one picture turns from one run to the next: the timber does not move and the plants do. On paper the same band of each picture stands one above another.
statement: A growth scenario on stated assumptions, not a forecast. Concept geometry; trial planting.

words.title: Grown three times
now: One corner of the room, grown on a computer.
The same room, grown again. We changed nothing.
And a third time. Watch the timber, then the plants.
card: The same room is grown three times: the same timber, the same plants in the same beds, the same gardener. The timber comes out the same. The plants do not.
Designing the timber for plants we cannot control.
How much real plants vary. The plant numbers in the simulator are assumptions.
words.alt: One pier of a timber room with climbing plants on it. The picture turns between three growings: the timber stays exactly where it is, and the plants are different in each.
